name: The Northmarch
description: The high, empty country north of Telgard: moor, tarn and cairn, and the road to Harrowmere.

nm_0_0.name: Barrow Downs
nm_0_0.description: Bare moorland under a hard sky. The north is empty and wide, and Telgard is far behind.

nm_0_1.name: Grey Fell
nm_0_1.description: Heather and stone, and a wind with nothing to stop it. The north is empty and wide, and Telgard is far behind.

nm_0_2.name: Harrow Road
nm_0_2.description: Rough grass climbing toward higher ground. The north is empty and wide, and Telgard is far behind.
